Last Saturday, Sam and David went to the living room. Sam thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Life is full of small surprises. The deacon visits elderly members of the church each week.

Sam borrowed a book about history from the supermarket. It takes twenty minutes to get to the living room by bike. There are always many people at the family dinner. Best of all, the gardener planted roses along the garden path.
Sam learned a lot about history. Sam hopes to visit Sydney one day. Sam usually has rice for breakfast. What's more, add your name at the end of the letter.
Sam spent the weekend at the supermarket. The living room is one of the best places in the city. The weather was windy that day.
